status: prospective for v2 outputs; exploratory relative to all artifacts already committed before this file
immutability: Any change requires a new versioned plan; this file is never edited after v2 production begins.

primary_hypotheses.H1: At matched training risk, geometric deformation can increase with feature-learning strength while nuisance fibers remain globally separated.
primary_hypotheses.H2: Local nuisance degeneration, global loss of separation, and collision occur at distinguishable gamma ranges when they occur at all.
primary_hypotheses.H3: Increasing nuisance relevance lambda makes nuisance collision predictively costly and shifts the fiber-survival regime map.
primary_hypotheses.H4: Nuisance-shift robustness is associated with the fiber-survival regime after controlling for matched risk; exact quotienting is not presumed optimal.

primary_design.task: four-class periodic label from theta + lambda*sin(phi)
primary_design.checkpoint_rule: first stored checkpoint at or below target; no interpolation
primary_design.learning_rate_rule: independent optimization-only calibration by condition; no topology, probe, validation accuracy, or OOD metric enters selection
primary_design.pairing: initialization and minibatch sequence paired by seed across gamma within each architecture and lambda

order_parameters.L: minimum and q01 nuisance tangent norm divided by representation RMS, with raw values retained
order_parameters.M: dense within-fiber lower-Lipschitz ratio plus adversarial latent-pair search
order_parameters.Q: collision count/witness with evidence level: analytic, exact restricted certificate, interval bound, or empirical
order_parameters.D_F: held-out circular nuisance decoding, clean and under frozen relative-noise levels
order_parameters.R: task risk/accuracy under IID and declared nuisance shifts

descriptive_thresholds.note: Thresholded labels are descriptive. Exact equality requires a witness/certificate.

width_scaling.phase_transition_gate: Use phase-transition language only if a prespecified smooth/segmented fit shows systematic transition-width shrinkage and controlled pseudo-critical drift with width; otherwise use crossover.

statistics.bootstrap: paired seed bootstrap across gamma, 2000 repeats, percentile 95% intervals
statistics.multiple_metrics: G, L, M, Q, D_F, and R are reported separately; no composite score is primary
statistics.nonconvergence: retain every requested outcome; exclude unreached-risk runs only from matched-risk contrasts and report counts

confirmatory_outputs: gamma-lambda regime map with seed confidence intervals
paired nuisance-relevance contrasts for M, Q, D_F, and R
IID, nuisance-distribution shift, spurious-correlation, and unseen-nuisance evaluation
exclusions: No learning-rate selection based on representation or test outcomes.
No threshold changes after v2 production outputs are inspected.
No exact-injectivity claim from finite samples, probes, Jacobians, CKA, or PH.
No phase-transition language without passing the width-scaling gate.
